segments.name: P&C insurance software
segments.description: Provides cloud-based core insurance software and digital, analytics, and AI capabilities to property and casualty insurers of all sizes worldwide.
segments.evidence: The Company has one reportable segment that conducts business globally and is managed, operated, and organized on a consolidated basis.

revenueModel.text: Property and casualty insurers pay subscription fees for the core platform, priced by premium managed on it, plus term licenses, support and professional services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generally price our subscription services for core products based on the amount of Direct Written Premium ("DWP") managed on our platform, with certain cloud-delivered products priced based on usage and associated resource consumption.
